scope: 36 fixed UCI development episodes, 3 repeats per task/fact. Read-only original rewards plus factual action/feedback extraction; no world/model/SQL rerun or reward re-evaluation. No other candidate ranking.

resource.scope: One process on a shared GPU; elapsed is not pure GPU compute.

original_progress.method_scope: Descriptive per-episode labels only; not support or empirical b. Saved b remains per original window/xi/theta/Gamma/member.
original_progress.missing_rule: Rates/means withheld unless all distinct planned measurements are known. No reward or completion is imputed for unknown/open/not_started.

sampling.scope: Actual recorded measurement counted once. Missing/live unrecorded usage is unknown, not invented zero cost.

evaluation_guard.scope: Only Torch CPU/CUDA RNG is restored. Probe window IDs, logs and generation/cache counters remain real; learner tensors and steps are never rolled back.

writes.unpackaged_sql_text:
WITH sales_only AS (
    SELECT
        InvoiceNo,
        CustomerID,
        SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) AS revenue_pence,
        COUNT(DISTINCT InvoiceNo) AS invoice_count
    FROM
        data
    WHERE
        InvoiceNo NOT LIKE 'C%' AND
        Quantity > 0 AND
        UnitPrice > 0
    GROUP BY
        InvoiceNo, CustomerID
),

net_signed AS (
    SELECT
        InvoiceNo,
        CustomerID,
        SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) AS revenue_pence,
        COUNT(DISTINCT InvoiceNo) AS invoice_count
    FROM
        data
    WHERE
        InvoiceNo NOT LIKE 'C%' AND
        Quantity > 0 AND
        UnitPrice > 0 AND
        Quantity * UnitPrice > 0
    GROUP BY
        InvoiceNo, CustomerID
)

SELECT
    t.CustomerID,
    COALESCE(s.revenue_pence, 0) AS revenue_pence,
    COALESCE(s.invoice_count, 0) AS invoice_count
FROM
    data AS t
    LEFT JOIN sales_only AS s ON t.CustomerID = s.CustomerID
    LEFT JOIN net_signed AS n ON t.CustomerID = n.CustomerID

measurement_limits: The old helper diagnose_events is used only as a pure trace extractor; its domain-neutral alias/reference relationships cover UCI. No v0.14 numeric evaluator is called.
Basis present in an actual build request is evidence exposure/use of exact source references, not proof the SQL implements its semantic policy.
Changed SQL and successful execution are not independent business correctness. Original terminal components are reported with their actual applicable denominators.
A different next request accepted by a tool is not automatically error repair. Verified repairs require a named obligation fixed and an actual subsequent build consuming it.
Only selected source documents needed for SQL text differences were hash-checked here; first-six receipt verification and final report evidence are reused instead of repeating all receipt checks.

Legacy models-projection difference flags count deletion/replacement of the models field; this report explicitly separates wrong-container SQL, result tables written as code, unchanged copies and valid packaged SQL edits.

For execution_error records, selected_current_code_at_build_call identifies the code version supplied to the executor; it does not assert that malformed code reached a SQL statement. Executed changed packaged SQL additionally requires successful execution and a recognized models edit.
